description: Parking question with real driving directions and details

messages.content: is there parking

content.text: There are three parking options:

steps.text: Under-building parking — 5 patient-reserved spaces, arrive early. From Centre St, turn left on Seaverns Ave, left on Alfred St, left on Green St. Entrance is under the building
Street parking on Centre Street — metered, 1-2 hour limit. Can be hard to find during business hours
Burroughs Street public lot — continue past the health center on Centre St, turn right on Burroughs. About a 1 block walk back

content.text: The under-building parking is most convenient but fills up fast. I'd recommend getting there early if you can.
